unit_pptx_name: Term 4 Week 4 - Plan and Draft - Year 5-6 Literacy.pptx
anchor: Claim it. Prove it. Sell it. One five-paragraph persuasive piece (introduction, body 1, body 2, answer back, conclusion), built as mine (zoo letter), ours (class shade letter), yours. Replaces the four-session Week 4 deck; Essential Assessment sessions sit outside this deck.

lessons.title: Plan It and Open Strong
lessons.focus: Plan the whole piece for one reader (two reasons, strongest last) and draft the introduction: hook, context, position, preview. Critical feature: by the end of the introduction the reader knows what you want and why. Retrieves: Week 3 hooks, Week 1 Issue Card.

lessons.title: Build Your Body
lessons.focus: Draft two body paragraphs: topic sentence, proof, This means..., with linking words by job. Critical feature: the first sentence is the claim. Retrieves: Week 2 proof, the Claim it / Prove it / Sell it anchor.

lessons.title: Answer Back and Finish Strong
lessons.focus: Draft the answer back (Some people say... However... proof) and the conclusion (restate echoing the hook, sum up, call to action). Critical feature: the conclusion ends with one clear thing the reader can do. Retrieves: Week 1 other side, Session 1 hook.
